checklists.name: Swift iOS Engineering Standards
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Swift memory management (ARC), SwiftUI / UIKit state architecture, and iOS security.

items.statement: Automatic Reference Counting (ARC) memory cycles are prevented using [weak self] or [unowned self] in closures.
SwiftUI / Combine state wrappers (@State, @StateObject, @ObservedObject) follow strict unidirectional data flow.
SwiftLint style rules are enforced with zero unhandled compiler or linter warnings.
Sensitive tokens and credentials use iOS Keychain storage with biometric (LocalAuthentication) protection.
App Store privacy manifests (PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy) accurately declare data collection categories.

obligationDefinitions.title: CocoaPods/SPM dependencies and deprecated iOS APIs must be tracked
obligationDefinitions.description: A Swift/iOS app's CocoaPods/Swift Package Manager dependencies and its usage of iOS SDK APIs both drift as Apple deprecates APIs each release; both must be tracked and remediated before the next OS version removes what's deprecated.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Dependencies are scanned for vulnerabilities and deprecated API usage is migrated within the declared cadence.

requiredEvidence.title: Dependency/deprecation scan
requiredEvidence.description: Xcode build warnings for deprecated APIs plus dependency vulnerability scan output.
requiredEvidence.collectionMethod: Automated Xcode build analysis plus dependency scan.
